executive_summary: The KYC Compliance Policy 2025 shows moderate compliance with RBI Microfinance Institution Directions. Critical gaps exist in customer due diligence for microfinance borrowers and income assessment methodology. The policy partially addresses loan documentation but lacks specific provisions for microfinance loan cards. Immediate attention needed for 3 critical and 2 high-severity gaps.
priority_actions: Address missing customer due diligence framework for microfinance borrowers immediately
Update income assessment methodology to include household income verification
Resolve conflicting provisions on loan pricing transparency vs existing fee structure
Strengthen weak clauses on borrower grievance redressal mechanism
Add provisions for repayment capacity assessment per RBI guidelines

gaps.description: The policy completely lacks provisions for customer due diligence specific to microfinance borrowers. RBI requires specialized KYC procedures for microfinance lending.
gaps.suggested_fix: Add a dedicated section on Microfinance Customer Due Diligence covering simplified KYC for small-value loans and field verification protocols.

regulation_clause.title: Customer Due Diligence for Microfinance Borrowers
regulation_clause.text: Every NBFC-MFI shall carry out customer due diligence of all microfinance borrowers.

metadata.regulatory_risk: Non-compliance may result in penalties and license suspension.
similar_clauses: Section 3.1 of existing KYC policy covers general due diligence
metadata.draft_clause:
4.1 Microfinance Customer Due Diligence
All microfinance borrowers shall undergo customer due diligence proportionate to the loan amount.

gaps.description: No provisions for income assessment and repayment capacity analysis of microfinance borrowers.
gaps.suggested_fix: Implement income assessment framework with household income verification and debt-to-income ratio.

regulation_clause.title: Income Assessment and Repayment Capacity
regulation_clause.text: NBFC-MFI shall assess household income and ensure total indebtedness does not exceed limits.

metadata.regulatory_risk: Over-indebtedness of borrowers and regulatory action.
metadata.draft_clause: 5.1 Income Assessment: Assess household annual income and verify monthly repayment capacity.

corrections.reason: This gap is a false positive - our existing policy Section 2.3 already covers PEP screening

gaps.description: The policy mentions borrower grievance redressal but uses weak language ('may' instead of 'shall') and lacks specific timelines.
gaps.suggested_fix: Updated remediation text after human review

policy_clause.title: Borrower Grievance Mechanism
policy_clause.text: The company may address borrower grievances through available channels.

regulation_clause.title: Grievance Redressal Framework
regulation_clause.text: Complaints shall be acknowledged within 3 days and resolved within 14 days.

metadata.draft_clause: 8.1 The company SHALL acknowledge complaints within 3 working days and resolve within 14 working days.

suggested_fix.old: Strengthen to use mandatory language with specific resolution timelines (7 days general, 14 days complex).
suggested_fix.new: Updated remediation text after human review

gaps.description: Policy fee structure allows processing charges up to 5% which directly conflicts with the regulation cap of 1% for microfinance loans.
gaps.suggested_fix: Amend fee structure to cap at 1% for microfinance loans per RBI mandated caps.

policy_clause.title: Loan Processing Fees
policy_clause.text: Processing charges of up to 5% of the sanctioned loan amount shall be applicable.

regulation_clause.title: Pricing Guidelines for Microfinance Loans
regulation_clause.text: Processing charge shall not exceed 1% of the loan amount. No penalty on delayed payment.

metadata.regulatory_risk: Direct violation of RBI pricing guidelines. Immediate regulatory action possible.
legal_citations: Fair Practices Code for NBFCs Section 3
metadata.draft_clause: 6.1 For microfinance loans: (a) Processing charge max 1% (b) No prepayment penalty (c) Interest rate per RBI benchmark.

gaps.description: Loan documentation covers general requirements but missing microfinance loan cards, vernacular language, and cooling-off period provisions.
gaps.suggested_fix: Add loan card in vernacular language, borrower rights pamphlet, and cooling-off period notice.

policy_clause.title: Loan Documentation
policy_clause.text: All loans shall be accompanied by proper documentation including loan agreement and KYC documents.

regulation_clause.title: Loan Card Requirements
regulation_clause.text: Borrower shall receive loan card in vernacular language with full loan details and grievance officer contact.

legal_citations: Fair Practices Code for MFI Section 5
metadata.draft_clause: 7.1 Microfinance borrowers shall receive: (a) Loan card in vernacular language (b) Borrower rights pamphlet (c) Cooling-off period notice.

gaps.description: Data protection mentioned but missing digital data consent, storage periods, and third-party sharing restrictions.
gaps.suggested_fix: Add explicit consent forms, 5-year storage policy, and third-party data sharing restrictions.

policy_clause.title: Customer Data Protection
policy_clause.text: The company shall protect customer personal information.

regulation_clause.title: Digital Data Protection
regulation_clause.text: Explicit consent required for digital data collection. 5-year storage post closure.

metadata.draft_clause: 9.1 Obtain explicit consent for digital data; keep for 5 years post closure.

gaps.description: Training clause uses vague language about frequency. Regulation requires quarterly mandatory training with assessment.
gaps.suggested_fix: Specify quarterly mandatory training with documented attendance and 80% minimum assessment score.

policy_clause.title: Staff Training
policy_clause.text: Employees should receive periodic training on compliance matters.

regulation_clause.title: Mandatory Staff Training
regulation_clause.text: Quarterly mandatory training with documented attendance and assessment.

metadata.regulatory_risk: Untrained staff may violate fair practices.
metadata.draft_clause: 10.1 All staff SHALL complete quarterly compliance training with minimum 80% assessment score.

gaps.description: Audit provisions lack microfinance portfolio audit, field visit audits, and concurrent audit requirements.
gaps.suggested_fix: Add concurrent audit of MFI operations, quarterly field visits (10% branches), annual portfolio review.

policy_clause.title: Audit Framework
policy_clause.text: Regular internal audits of compliance procedures.

regulation_clause.title: Microfinance Audit Requirements
regulation_clause.text: Concurrent audit of MFI operations, quarterly field visits covering 10% branches.

metadata.draft_clause: 11.1 Concurrent audit for MFI operations; quarterly field visits covering 10% of branches.

gaps.description: Aadhaar-based e-KYC implementation fully meets electronic identity verification requirements.

policy_clause.title: Electronic Identity Verification
policy_clause.text: Aadhaar-based e-KYC for customer identity verification.

gaps.description: AML suspicious transaction reporting adequately covers FIU-IND requirements.

regulation_clause.title: AML Reporting
regulation_clause.text: Report to FIU-IND. CTR for cash above Rs 10 lakhs.
